newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK EASIER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK EASIER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier on the U.S. unit, sterling and the rand compared to Friday's levels but registered a slight gain against the mark in quiet Monday morning interbank trade, dealers said.
"The market is pretty quiet and I haven't seen any movement yet," said one dealer.
At around 0820 GMT the local unit was trading at 11.3100/3200 against the U.S. dollar, half a cent down from Friday's 11.3050/3150 and was at 18.5090/5310 from 18.4800/5000 against sterling.
It was also a touch softer on the rand at 2.5120/5150 from 2.5100/5300 but was quoted firmer on the mark at 6.5180/5260 compared to 6.5400/5600.
